intro.en: Beer, Bays & German Heritage — Tsingtao Brewery, Zhanqiao Pier & Badaguan. Coastal elegance meets European colonial history.
intro.zh: 啤酒、海湾与德式遗风 — 青岛啤酒、栈桥与八大关。中西合璧的海滨名城。

culture.en: Beer, Bays & German Heritage — Tsingtao Brewery, Zhanqiao Pier & Badaguan. Coastal elegance meets European colonial history.
culture.zh: 啤酒、海湾与德式遗风 — 青岛啤酒、栈桥与八大关。中西合璧的海滨名城。

climate.en: Temperate marine climate. Summer 25-28°C (peak season), spring/autumn mild.
climate.zh: 温带海洋性气候。夏季25-28°C（旺季），春秋温和。

transit.en: Metro lines 2-3 plus buses; Jiaodong Airport 30km.
transit.zh: 地铁2-3号线加公交；胶东机场30公里。

intercity.en: High-speed rail from Jinan (~1.5h), Beijing (~3h), Shanghai.
intercity.zh: 济南高铁约1.5小时、北京约3小时、上海可达。

tips.en: Visit in Aug for beer festival; coastal bike path is scenic.
tips.zh: 8月啤酒节最热闹；滨海骑行道风景佳。
